title: dnaa-7 RIDA-rate calibration — the operating window (RIDA 0.5-0.7)
caption: RIDA_RATE_MULTIPLIER sweep (DARS on), mechanistic oriC-low trigger + cooperativity, seed 1, 8 gens. TOP: DnaA-ATP fraction (g3+ mean) vs RIDA rate — falls monotonically (0.85 at 0.1 -> 0.03 at 1.0); in the [0.2,0.5] band only for RIDA 0.5-0.7 (shaded operating window). BOTTOM: re-initiation ticks + max oriC vs RIDA rate — RIDA >= 0.5 gives 0 re-inits and clean oriC 2. The overlap (RIDA 0.5-0.7) satisfies BOTH: clean one-init-per-cycle AND the in-band DnaA-ATP fraction; canonical operating point RIDA=0.6 (fraction 0.398).
interpretation: There is a genuine operating window for the mechanistic DnaA-ATP/oriC initiation: RIDA 0.5-0.7 (with DARS reactivation) gives clean oriC 1<->2, zero re-initiations, the DnaA-ATP fraction in [0.2,0.5], and the DnaA pool in band, with 8/8 divisions. So RIDA both enforces once-per-cycle (resets the switch) and, at the right rate, leaves DnaA-ATP in its physiological band. The DnaA-ATP/oriC mechanism fully and in-band replaces the cell-mass heuristic. Single-seed (seed 1); multi-seed robustness + a per-origin hemimethylation SeqA model are the open refinements.
